codeSnippets.output: Adds a new list item to the #task-list element.

exercise.instruction: Complete the to-do app: attach a submit listener to #todo-form that preventDefaults, reads #task-input, trims it, skips empty values, creates an li with the task text, appends it to #task-list, then clears and refocuses the input.
hints: Hint 2: Inside: event.preventDefault(); const input = document.querySelector("#task-input"); const task = input.value.trim(); if (!task) return;
Hint 3: const li = document.createElement("li"); li.textContent = task; list.appendChild(li); input.value = ""; input.focus();
